blueprint.name: Recruitment Test
blueprint.source: UPSC APFC Recruitment Test: single 2-hour objective paper, 160 questions, 300 marks, -1/3 negative. Syllabus areas mapped to bank sections; Industrial Relations and Accountancy have no reviewed-bank source and are model-filled, labelled as such.

questions.text: As per the table below showing the Sectoral Composition of Gross Value Added (GVA) at Basic Prices (in approximate percentages) for selected years, what is the difference in the share of the Services sector between 2023-24 and 1950-51 (in percentage points)? Table: Sectoral Share in GVA (%) | Year | Agriculture & Allied | Industry | Services | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 1950-51 | 50 | 20 | 30 | | 1990-91 | 30 | 25 | 45 | | 2023-24 | 15 | 25 | 60 |
questions.solution: Shortcut: Percentage point difference requires simple subtraction, not percentage change calculation. Subtract the 1950-51 Services share (30%) from the 2023-24 share (60%). 60 - 30 = 30 percentage points. Worked Solution: Services share (2023-24) = 60%. Services share (1950-51) = 30%. Difference = 60% - 30% = 30 percentage points.

questions.text: A sum of money becomes 1.44 times itself in 2 years at compound interest compounded annually. What is the annual rate of interest?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Since amount = P(1+r)^2 = 1.44P, take square root: 1+r = √1.44 = 1.2 → r = 0.2 = 20%. Full: Let principal be P, rate r. After 2 years, A = P(1+r)^2 = 1.44P ⇒ (1+r)^2 = 1.44 ⇒ 1+r = 1.2 ⇒ r = 0.2 = 20%.

questions.text: Two runners A and B start simultaneously from the same point on a circular track of length 600 metres. They run in the same direction with speeds of 20 km/h and 30 km/h respectively. After how much time will they meet at the starting point for the first time?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Time to meet at the starting point = LCM(Time taken by A for one round, Time taken by B for one round). Step-by-step: Convert speeds to m/s: A = 20 × 5/18 = 50/9 m/s; B = 30 × 5/18 = 25/3 m/s. Time for one round: A = 600 / (50/9) = 108 sec; B = 600 / (25/3) = 72 sec. LCM(108, 72) = 216 seconds = 3 minutes 36 seconds.
questions.topic: Time, Speed and Distance - Circular Tracks

questions.text: The Constitution (One Hundred and Sixth Amendment) Act, 2023 (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam) provides for reservation of one-third of seats for women in the Lok Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies, and the Legislative Assembly of NCT of Delhi. For what initial period shall this reservation provision remain in force as per Article 334A?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Unlike the 10-year renewal cycle for SC/ST reservations (Art 334), the new Art 334A for women fixes a distinct 15-year term. Eliminate 10 years (legacy cycle) and non-standard longer periods (20, 25). Step-by-step: Article 334A(3), inserted by the 106th Amendment, explicitly states: 'The provisions of this article shall remain in force for a period of fifteen years from the date of commencement...'. Parliament may extend it later, but the initial constitutional mandate is 15 years.

questions.text: Choose the most appropriate option to fill in the blank: The forensic report ______ the witness's testimony, confirming the sequence of events on the night of the incident.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Context Elimination — 'Report' (subject) acts on 'Testimony' (object) to validate it. Test each phrasal verb: 'Bear out' = corroborate/confirm (Fits); 'Bear up' = endure pressure (Intransitive, no object); 'Bear with' = be patient (Requires human object); 'Bear on' = be relevant to (Takes 'on/upon', not direct object). Only Option A fits transitive 'confirm' meaning. Worked Solution: 1) Analyse sentence logic: Forensic report + Testimony → Relationship = Support/Proof. 2) Evaluate A: 'Bore out' means to substantiate/confirm evidence. Perfect fit. 3) Evaluate B: 'Bore up' means to withstand stress; intransitive. 4) Evaluate C: 'Bore with' means tolerate; used as 'bear with me'. 5) Evaluate D: 'Bore on' means relate to; structure 'bear on the issue'. 6) Select A.

questions.text: Two trains of lengths 150 m and 250 m run on parallel tracks. When running in opposite directions, they cross each other completely in 10 seconds. When running in the same direction, the faster train crosses the slower train completely in 40 seconds. What is the speed of the faster train in km/h?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Total distance = 400 m. Relative speed (opposite) = 400/10 = 40 m/s. Relative speed (same) = 400/40 = 10 m/s. Speed of faster train = (40 + 10)/2 = 25 m/s = 25 × 18/5 = 90 km/h. Full Solution: Let speeds be x and y m/s (x > y). Opposite direction: x + y = 400/10 = 40. Same direction: x - y = 400/40 = 10. Adding equations: 2x = 50 ⇒ x = 25 m/s. Converting to km/h: 25 × (18/5) = 90 km/h.

questions.text: In a coded language, 'MOTHER' is written as 'OQVJGT'. If the pattern involves shifting each letter by +2 positions in the alphabet (e.g., M->O), how would 'FATHER' be written?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Identify the shift rule from the example. M(13)+2=O(15), O(15)+2=Q(17), T(20)+2=V(22), H(8)+2=J(10), E(5)+2=G(7), R(18)+2=T(20). Apply +2 shift to FATHER: F->H, A->C, T->V, H->J, E->G, R->T. Result: HCVJGT. Full Solution: F(6)+2=H(8), A(1)+2=C(3), T(20)+2=V(22), H(8)+2=J(10), E(5)+2=G(7), R(18)+2=T(20). Concatenate letters: HCVJGT.

questions.text: One morning after sunrise, Rahul stands facing a pole. The shadow of the pole falls exactly to his right. Which direction is Rahul facing?
questions.solution: Shortcut: At sunrise, the sun is in the East, so shadows fall towards the West. If the shadow (West) is to Rahul's right, he must be facing South (since West is to the right of a person facing South). Step-by-step: Sun rises in East → Shadow direction = West. Shadow is on Right → Facing direction = South (Right hand points West when facing South).

questions.text: In a coded language, 'FAMILY' is written as 'HDKPZ'. If the pattern involves shifting each letter by +2 positions in the alphabet, how would 'CHILDREN' be written?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Apply the +2 shift rule to each letter individually. D(+2)=F, O(+2)=Q, G(+2)=I. Result: FQI.

questions.text: As per the table below showing Monthly Gross GST Revenue Collections (in ₹ Lakh Crore) for the first quarter of a Financial Year, what is the approximate average monthly collection for the quarter? Table: Monthly GST Collections (Q1) | Month | Collection (₹ Lakh Crore) | | :--- | :--- | | April | 1.68 | | May | 1.57 | | June | 1.61 |
questions.solution: Shortcut: Sum the unit digits (8+7+1=16), so total sum ends in 6. Average = Sum/3. Only option ending in 2 (1.62 * 3 = 4.86) produces a sum ending in 6. Worked Solution: Total = 1.68 + 1.57 + 1.61 = 4.86 Lakh Crore. Average = 4.86 / 3 = 1.62 Lakh Crore.

questions.text: As per the table below showing Literacy Rates (Census 2011) for selected major states, the difference between the Male and Female literacy rates (Gender Gap) is the lowest for which state? Table: Literacy Rates Census 2011 (Percentage) | State | Male | Female | Total | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Kerala | 96.1 | 92.1 | 94.0 | | Maharashtra | 88.4 | 75.9 | 82.3 | | Bihar | 71.2 | 51.5 | 61.8 | | Rajasthan | 79.2 | 52.1 | 66.1 |
questions.solution: Shortcut: Scan the Female literacy column. The state with the highest female literacy rate (Kerala, 92.1%) will almost certainly have the smallest gap with the male rate, as male literacy saturates near 95-96%. Worked Solution: Kerala Gap = 96.1 - 92.1 = 4.0%. Maharashtra Gap = 88.4 - 75.9 = 12.5%. Bihar Gap = 71.2 - 51.5 = 19.7%. Rajasthan Gap = 79.2 - 52.1 = 27.1%. Kerala has the lowest gap.

questions.text: As per the table below listing key policy bodies in India and their year of establishment, in which year was the NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) established by a Union Cabinet resolution?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Government transition year. NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission (est. 1950) after the NDA government took office in May 2014. The resolution was passed on January 1, 2015. Option A (2014) is the election year, not establishment. Options C/D are too late. Step-by-step: The Planning Commission was dissolved in August 2014. The Union Cabinet resolved to establish NITI Aayog on January 1, 2015. It serves as the premier policy 'Think Tank' of the Government of India, providing directional and policy inputs.

questions.text: As per the table below showing the Vertical Devolution (Share of States in Central Taxes) recommended by the last three Finance Commissions, what is the approximate average percentage share recommended for the States? Table: Finance Commission Recommendations | Finance Commission | Award Period | States' Share (%) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | XIII | 2010-2015 | 32 | | XIV | 2015-2020 | 42 | | XV | 2021-2026 | 41 |
questions.solution: Shortcut: Sum the three percentages (32 + 42 + 41 = 115) and divide by 3. 115/3 ≈ 38.33%. Select the option closest to 38%. Worked Solution: Average = (32 + 42 + 41) / 3 = 115 / 3 = 38.33%. The approximate average is 38%.

questions.text: Select the word which is correctly spelt.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use spelling mnemonics: 'Accommodate' has room for double 'c' and double 'm'; 'Definitely' contains the root 'finite'; 'Occurrence' has a double 'r' that occurs twice; 'Privilege' has no 'd'. Elimination: A misses second 'm'; B substitutes 'a' for 'i'; D inserts a 'd'. Option C is flawless.

questions.text: Under the Code on Social Security, 2020, what is the minimum number of employees required for an establishment to be compulsorily covered under the Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Scheme?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use the unified threshold mnemonic **"ESI = 10, EPF = 20"**. The Code on Social Security, 2020 eliminated the old ESI Act distinction (10 with power / 20 without) and fixed a uniform threshold of 10 employees for all establishments. Worked Solution: Section 41(1) of the Code on Social Security, 2020 states that the ESI provisions apply to 'every establishment in which 10 or more persons are employed or were employed on any day of the preceding 12 months'. This is a key reform unifying the coverage criteria. Option A (10) is correct. Option C (20) is the threshold for EPF coverage under the same Code.
questions.topic: Code on Social Security, 2020 - ESI Coverage Threshold

questions.text: As per the Interim Union Budget 2024-25 presented by the Finance Minister on February 1, 2024, what is the estimated Fiscal Deficit target for FY 2024-25 (Budget Estimate) as a percentage of GDP?
questions.solution: Shortcut: FY24 Revised Estimate (RE) was 5.8%. The glide path aims for <4.5% by FY26. The FY25 Budget Estimate (BE) must lie between the FY24 RE (5.8%) and the medium-term target (4.5%). Eliminate 5.8% (FY24 RE), 4.5% (FY26 Target), and 6.2% (Old FY24 BE). Worked: The Interim Budget 2024-25 pegged the Fiscal Deficit for FY25 at 5.1% of GDP, lower than the revised estimate of 5.8% for FY24. The Finance Minister reiterated the commitment to reduce the fiscal deficit below 4.5% of GDP by FY26.

questions.text: In the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting held on February 8, 2024, the Reserve Bank of India decided to keep the Policy Repo Rate unchanged for the sixth consecutive time. At what level was the Policy Repo Rate maintained?
questions.solution: Shortcut: The Repo Rate was last changed in Feb 2023 (hiked to 6.50%). Since then, every MPC meeting (Apr, Jun, Aug, Oct, Dec 2023, Feb 2024) has maintained status quo. Eliminate 6.00%/6.25% (pre-hike levels) and 6.75% (MSF rate). Worked: The MPC meeting held Feb 6-8, 2024, voted 5:1 to keep the Policy Repo Rate unchanged at 6.50%. Consequently, the SDF rate remains 6.25% and the MSF/Bank Rate remains 6.75%. The Real GDP growth projection for FY25 was retained at 7.0%.

questions.text: The average age of a family of 5 members is 24 years. If the youngest member, who was 6 years old at the time of calculation, were to be excluded, what would be the new average age?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Total age of 4 members = 25 * 4 = 100 years. Subtract youngest member's age (10 years): 100 - 10 = 90 years. Divide by remaining 3 members: 90 / 3 = 30 years.

questions.text: As per the table below showing the number of Ramsar Sites (Wetlands of International Importance) in selected Indian States (as of January 2024), the number of sites in Tamil Nadu constitutes approximately what percentage of the total sites in these four states? Table: State-wise Ramsar Sites (Top 4 States) | State | Number of Sites | | :--- | :--- | | Tamil Nadu | 16 | | Uttar Pradesh | 10 | | Punjab | 6 | | Odisha | 6 |
questions.solution: Shortcut: Total sites = 16 + 10 + 6 + 6 = 38. Tamil Nadu share = 16/38. Approximate 16/40 = 40%. Since denominator (38) is less than 40, actual percentage is slightly > 40%. Option 42% is closest. Worked Solution: Total = 38. Percentage = (16/38) * 100 = 42.1% ≈ 42%.

questions.text: What is the unit digit of the expression (7^95 - 3^58)?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Cyclicity Method): Unit digit of powers of 7 repeats in cycle of 4: 7, 9, 3, 1. 95 mod 4 = 3 => Unit digit of 7^95 = 3rd in cycle = 3. Unit digit of powers of 3 repeats in cycle of 4: 3, 9, 7, 1. 58 mod 4 = 2 => Unit digit of 3^58 = 2nd in cycle = 9. Unit digit of (3 - 9) = (13 - 9) = 4 (borrowing 10). Full Solution: Cyclicity of 7 is 4. 95 = 4*23 + 3. Unit digit of 7^95 = Unit digit of 7^3 = 343 = 3. Cyclicity of 3 is 4. 58 = 4*14 + 2. Unit digit of 3^58 = Unit digit of 3^2 = 9. Since 3 < 9, we consider (10+3) - 9 = 4. Therefore, the unit digit is 4.

questions.text: As per AS 29 (Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets), which of the following conditions requires the recognition of a **Provision** in the financial statements?

options.label: A
options.text: A present obligation arising from a past event, where the outflow of resources is **remote**.

options.label: B
options.text: A **possible** obligation arising from a past event, where the outflow of resources is probable.

options.label: C
options.text: A present obligation arising from a past event, where the outflow of resources is **probable** and a reliable estimate can be made.

options.label: D
options.text: A present obligation arising from a past event, where no reliable estimate can be made.

questions.solution: **Shortcut (The 3-P Rule):** A Provision requires three simultaneous conditions: **P**resent Obligation (not possible), **P**robable Outflow (>50%, not remote), **P**recise/Reliable Estimate. Scan options for all three. Only Option C satisfies all: Present Obligation + Probable Outflow + Reliable Estimate. Option A fails probability (Remote). Option B fails obligation type (Possible). Option D fails reliable estimate. **Step-by-Step:** 1. **AS 29 Para 14** states a provision is recognized only if: (a) An entity has a **present obligation** (legal or constructive) as a result of a **past event**; (b) It is **probable** (more likely than not) that an outflow of resources will be required to settle the obligation; (c) A **reliable estimate** can be made of the amount. 2. **Option A:** Outflow is 'remote' -> Disclose as Contingent Liability only if not remote, but here it is remote -> No recognition, no disclosure. 3. **Option B:** 'Possible' obligation -> Not a present obligation -> Treated as Contingent Liability (Disclosure only). 4. **Option C:** Matches all three criteria (Present, Probable, Reliable Estimate) -> **Recognize Provision**. 5. **Option D:** No reliable estimate -> Cannot recognize Provision -> Disclose as Contingent Liability.

questions.text: The river Narmada, one of the major west-flowing rivers of Peninsular India, originates from the Amarkantak plateau located in which state?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate Gujarat (river mouth), Maharashtra (Godavari/Tapi basins), and Chhattisgarh (Mahanadi source); Amarkantak is a unique hill station in the Maikal range falling in Anuppur district of Madhya Pradesh. Full Solution: The Narmada River originates from the Narmada Kund at Amarkantak in the Anuppur district of Madhya Pradesh at an elevation of about 1,057 meters.

questions.text: As per AS 22 (Accounting for Taxes on Income), the Written Down Value (WDV) of a block of assets as per books of account is ₹50 Lakhs and as per the Income Tax Act, 1961 is ₹30 Lakhs. The applicable income tax rate is 30%. Assuming no other timing differences exist, what is the amount and nature of the Deferred Tax to be recognised?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Deferred Tax = (Book WDV - Tax WDV) × Tax Rate. If Book WDV > Tax WDV → Deferred Tax Liability (DTL). Calculation: (50 - 30) × 30% = 20 × 0.3 = ₹6 Lakhs DTL. Step-by-step: 1. Compute Timing Difference: Book WDV (₹50L) minus Tax WDV (₹30L) = ₹20 Lakhs (Taxable Temporary Difference). 2. Determine Nature: Higher Book WDV implies lower depreciation charged in books compared to tax depreciation, resulting in higher current accounting income and higher future tax payments → Deferred Tax Liability. 3. Compute Amount: ₹20 Lakhs × 30% = ₹6 Lakhs DTL.

questions.text: The sum of the first 11 terms of an Arithmetic Progression (AP) is 330. If the first term of the AP is 5, what is the common difference?
questions.solution: Shortcut: For an AP with odd number of terms (n=11), Sum = n × Middle Term. Middle term (6th term) = 330/11 = 30. 6th term = a + 5d ⇒ 5 + 5d = 30 ⇒ d = 5. Full Solution: Sum formula S_n = n/2 [2a + (n-1)d]. 330 = 11/2 [2(5) + 10d] ⇒ 60 = 10 + 10d ⇒ 10d = 50 ⇒ d = 5.

questions.text: Choose the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no improvement is required, select 'No improvement'. Scarcely had the meeting started **than** the fire alarm rang.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Correlative Conjugation Pair Rule. Memorize the fixed pairs: **No sooner → Than** | **Hardly → When** | **Scarcely → When**. The stem uses 'Scarcely', so the mandatory partner is 'When'. Instantly eliminate 'Than' (Option A) and 'Then' (Option C). Step-by-step: 1. Identify the structure: 'Scarcely had...' triggers Subject-Auxiliary Inversion (Had the meeting started). 2. Recall the grammar rule: 'Scarcely' (and 'Hardly') are *always* followed by 'When' in standard English. 'No sooner' is followed by 'Than'. 3. The sentence incorrectly pairs 'Scarcely' with 'Than'. 4. Replace 'Than' with 'When'. 5. Option B 'when' corrects the correlation. Option D is incorrect because an error exists.

questions.text: Choose the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no improvement is required, select 'No improvement'. If he would have studied harder, he would have passed the examination.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate any option using 'would have' or 'would' in the 'if-clause' (conditional clause) as it violates the Type 3 Conditional rule (Past Unreal). The correct structure is 'Had + Subject + V3' (inversion) or 'If + Subject + had + V3'. Option B uses the standard formal inversion. Worked Solution: The sentence expresses a hypothetical past result. The condition clause requires Past Perfect tense. Option A uses Simple Past (incorrect for Type 3). Option C uses 'would study' (incorrect). Option D is invalid because the original sentence contains the error 'would have studied' in the if-clause. Option B ('Had he studied') is the grammatically correct inverted form of 'If he had studied'.

questions.text: As per the table below showing the Total Public Sector Outlay (in ₹ Crore) for the first five Five-Year Plans, which Plan recorded the highest percentage increase in outlay over its immediately preceding Plan? Table: Plan Outlays | Plan | Period | Outlay (₹ Crore) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | First | 1951-56 | 1,960 | | Second | 1956-61 | 4,600 | | Third | 1961-66 | 8,500 | | Fourth | 1969-74 | 15,780 | | Fifth | 1974-79 | 39,430 |
questions.solution: Shortcut: Compare the absolute jump relative to the base. The jump from 4th to 5th Plan is ~23,650 on a base of ~15,780 (~150%). The jump from 1st to 2nd is ~2,640 on a base of ~1,960 (~135%). Jumps for 3rd and 4th are ~85%. The 5th Plan's jump is largest in both absolute and relative terms. Worked Solution: 2nd Plan increase = (4600-1960)/1960 = 134.7%. 3rd Plan increase = (8500-4600)/4600 = 84.8%. 4th Plan increase = (15780-8500)/8500 = 85.6%. 5th Plan increase = (39430-15780)/15780 = 150.0%. Highest is 5th Plan.

questions.text: Under the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, what is the amount an employer is required to contribute to the Worker Re-skilling Fund for every worker retrenched?
questions.solution: **Shortcut (Elimination by Keyword Association):** Associate '15 days' with the standard statutory rate for *retrenchment compensation* (15 days avg pay per completed year) and *gratuity* (15 days wages per year). The Worker Re-skilling Fund is a *new, one-time* contribution per worker retrenched, fixed at the same base unit: **15 days last drawn wages**. Eliminate 'One month/30 days' (Notice Pay/Monthly salary) and '45 days' (Gratuity for 3+ years/Arbitrary). **Step-by-Step Solution:** 1. **Locate Provision:** Section 83 of the Industrial Relations Code, 2020 establishes the "Worker Re-skilling Fund". 2. **Identify Contribution Rate:** The Code mandates the employer to credit an amount equal to **15 days of last drawn wages** for *every worker retrenched*. 3. **Utilization:** This fund is utilized to pay the retrenched worker 15 days wages within 45 days of retrenchment. 4. **Distinction:** Do not confuse with Retrenchment Compensation (15 days *per completed year of service*) or Notice Pay (1 month/30 days). This is a fixed 15-day contribution per worker to a specific Fund.
questions.topic: Industrial Relations Code, 2020 - Worker Re-skilling Fund

questions.text: Identify the missing number in the series: 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, ?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Recognise the pattern as n²−1 starting from n=2: 2²−1=3, 3²−1=8, 4²−1=15, 5²−1=24, 6²−1=35, so the next term is 7²−1=48. Full steps: The successive differences are 5, 7, 9, 11 (increasing by 2); the next difference is 13, giving 35+13=48.

questions.text: Under the Code on Social Security, 2020, what is the gratuity entitlement for a Fixed Term Employee?

options.label: A
options.text: A) Entitled only after completing five years of continuous service like regular employees.

options.label: B
options.text: B) Entitled on a pro-rata basis only after completing one year of service.

options.label: C
options.text: C) Entitled on a pro-rata basis irrespective of the five-year continuous service condition.

options.label: D
options.text: D) Not entitled to gratuity as the employment is for a fixed duration.

questions.solution: Shortcut (Option Elimination): The Code on Social Security, 2020 explicitly removed the 5-year service condition for Fixed Term Employees (FTEs) to promote equity. Eliminate Option A (applies general rule, ignores specific FTE provision). Eliminate Option D (FTEs are entitled to statutory benefits). Eliminate Option B (no '1-year' threshold exists in the Code). Option C correctly captures the 'pro-rata without 5-year condition' rule. Full Solution: Section 53(1) of the Code prescribes the general rule: gratuity is payable after rendering continuous service of not less than five years. However, Section 53(3) contains a non-obstante clause: "Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1), in the case of a fixed term employee, gratuity shall be payable on a pro-rata basis." This statutory provision ensures FTEs receive gratuity proportionate to their service period without any minimum qualifying period of 5 years.
questions.topic: Code on Social Security, 2020 - Gratuity & Fixed Term Employment
